meta.note: Solved by graph/routing.js (unmodified) from graph/positions.json, regenerated 2026-08-31 to fix a lane-offset runaway (several services reached lane indices in the 60-90s -- e.g. air max lane 92 x 0.24m stock spacing = ~11m of lateral distortion -- because applyLanes() offsets each point perpendicular to its own local segment direction, so a large lane index does not shift a path sideways, it warps it into a locally-diagonal shape). Lane spacing is collapsed to the corridor centreline for this generation (every route has lane index 0 / 0m offset applied), mirroring the exact fix already established in graph/generate-rack-overlay.js for the same underlying issue in rack-internal routes. Also picks up any facility/hall connections added since the prior 2026-08-26 generation (route ids match connection ids one-to-one, regenerated from the CURRENT facility-graph.json + hall-graph.json, not a stale snapshot).
